instruction.hanzi: 给下面的词语选择对应的图片
instruction.english: Match the pictures with the phrases.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 你知道小王今天什么时候来学校吗?
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào Xiǎo Wáng jīntiān shénme shíhou lái xuéxiào ma?
dialogue.english: Do you know when Xiao Wang will come to school today?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme zhīdào tā lái le?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 我在门外看见他的自行车了。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ zài mén wài kànjiàn tā de zìxíngchē le.
dialogue.english: I saw his bike outside the door.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 今天的羊肉很好吃,你怎么不吃了?
dialogue.pinyin: Jīntiān de yángròu hěn hǎochī, nǐ zěnme bù chī le?
dialogue.english: The mutton today is excellent. Why don't you eat more?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 这个星期天天都吃羊肉,不想吃了。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhège xīngqī tiāntiān dōu chī yángròu, bù xiǎng chī le.
dialogue.english: I've eaten mutton every day this week. I don't want any more.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Nà nǐ hái xiǎng chī shénme?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 昨天你们怎么都没去打篮球?
dialogue.pinyin: Zuótiān nǐmen zěnme dōu méi qù dǎ lánqiú?
dialogue.english: Why didn't you guys go to play basketball yesterday?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 因为昨天下雨,所以我们都没去。我去游泳了。
dialogue.pinyin: Yīnwèi zuótiān xià yǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen dōu méi qù. Wǒ qù yóu yǒng le.
dialogue.english: Because it rained yesterday. I went swimming.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 这个月我天天游泳,我现在七十公斤了。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhège yuè wǒ tiāntiān yóu yǒng, wǒ xiànzài qīshí gōngjīn le.
dialogue.english: I swim every day this month. I weigh 70 kilograms now.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 这两天怎么没看见小张?
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiān zěnme méi kànjiàn Xiǎo Zhāng?
dialogue.english: I haven't seen Xiao Zhang for days. What's going on?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Qù Běijīng le? Shì qù lǚyóu ma?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 不是,听说是去看他姐姐。
dialogue.pinyin: Bú shì, tīngshuō shì qù kàn tā jiějie.
dialogue.english: No. Visiting his elder sister, as far as I've heard.

explanation.hanzi: 用"怎么+动词/形容词"询问事情的原因,多表示奇怪、惊讶的语气。
explanation.english: The structure "怎么 + verb/adjective" asks about the reason for something, often expressing surprise or astonishment.

explanation.hanzi: 量词重叠后表示"每一"的意思,常用来强调在某个范围内的每个成员都具有某种特征,后面一般用"都"。
explanation.english: A reduplicated measure word means "every/each", emphasizing that every member of a group shares a feature. It's usually followed by "都".

title.english: The Pair of Conjunctions "因为……,所以……"

explanation.hanzi: 连接两个表示因果关系的分句,前一分句表示原因,后一分句表示结果。使用时可以成对出现,也可以省略其中一个。
explanation.english: These conjunctions link two clauses in a cause-and-effect relation. The first clause is the cause; the second is the result. They may be used together or one of them omitted.

rows: 所以我们都没去(打篮球)。

prompt.english: Answer the questions based on the dialogs.

items.pinyin: Wèi shénme tā jīntiān bù xiǎng chī yángròu?

items.hanzi: 为什么昨天他们都没去打篮球?

Xiǎo Zhāng wèi shénme qù Běijīng?

singleComponentChars.etymology: "门" originally referred to the two panels of a door at the entrance of a house, which can open and close.
The original form of "羊" looks like a sheep's head facing forward. It means "sheep".
